fix_1_ttl_config.chosen_env_var_design: Single canonical source: repo Actions variable CLIPFORGE_TTL_SECONDS (created this session, value 172800 = 48h). Both workflows consume it via ${{ vars.CLIPFORGE_TTL_SECONDS || '172800' }} (cleanup.yml additionally allows a workflow_dispatch input override for ad-hoc sweeps). pipeline/status.py now resolves new-job TTL through configured_ttl_seconds(): explicit --ttl-seconds arg (passed by stage-a.yml from the same env var) > CLIPFORGE_TTL_SECONDS env var > DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS (12*3600, kept as documented no-config fallback for local runs/tests). The TELEGRAM BOT (bot/src/jobs.js::newStatus) was discovered during this fix to be the ACTUAL writer of every job's initial status.json — it had its own independent hardcoded DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS = 12*3600 and was the true source of the 12h expires_at_epoch baked into all existing jobs (verified: bot 'create job' commit 82bca3e wrote expires=created+43200 before stage A ever ran). Bot now resolves TTL via configuredJobTtlSeconds(env) reading worker var CLIPFORGE_JOB_TTL_SECONDS, set to '172800' in bot/wrangler.bot-a.jsonc, and all three newStatus call sites in bot/src/index.js (startJob, startRelayJob, startNextSeriesPart) pass ttlSeconds: configuredJobTtlSeconds(env). (bot-b relay worker writes no job status; its wrangler config needs no var.)

human_review_items: OPERATOR ACTION REQUIRED OUTSIDE THE REPO: bot/wrangler.bot-a.jsonc now sets CLIPFORGE_JOB_TTL_SECONDS=172800, but the Cloudflare Worker only picks it up on the next bot deploy (deploy-bots.yml runs on bot/** changes, so pushing this commit may auto-deploy; verify the deploy ran and the var is live). Until then the bot still creates jobs with the old 12h TTL baked in.

Single canonical TTL value now lives as the repo Actions variable CLIPFORGE_TTL_SECONDS=172800 (created via gh this session). The '172800' fallback literals in stage-a.yml/cleanup.yml/wrangler.bot-a.jsonc are deliberate in-repo mirrors, pinned by WorkflowTtlAgreementTests so they cannot drift without failing the suite.
